output.summary: An annual native to the Mediterranean, Middle East, India, Pakistan and Central Asia. Its woolly growth bears conspicuous three-part fruits that twist open and propel their seeds. Fruit-coat and leaf-sap extracts yielded a blue-purple dye historically used in manuscripts and as a food colorant, although consuming the plant may cause digestive illness.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit-coat or leaf-sap colorant was used in Dutch cheese and liquors, although consuming the plant may cause digestive illness.
